thread:
maya: Hey — customer on a Private deployment is seeing intermittent high latency then a 502 on /v1/generate. They gave a request ID: 01f3a9e2-9c4b-4a1e-b2d6. Need a clear repro + debug bundle instructions we can give them. They tried the presigned upload and hit 403 sometimes.
kevin: First ask them to pull the full gateway trace for that request ID (gateway logs + trace_id from our proxy). Also ask for the collector stdout/stderr and systemd journal around the time.
alejandra: For Private installs the collector lives on the host (usually /usr/local/bin/redwood-collector or /opt/redwood/collector). Quick steps for them to run: 
```
# run collector (online)
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-collector collect --request-id 01f3a9e2-9c4b-4a1e-b2d6 --output /tmp/redwood-debug-01f3a9e2.tar.gz --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.json
```
If they're air-gapped: 
```
# offline bundle (no presign)
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-collector collect --request-id 01f3a9e2-9c4b-4a1e-b2d6 --offline --output /tmp/redwood-debug-01f3a9e2.tar.gz --redact-config /etc/redwood/redact.json
# then scp to your laptop and sftp/scp to our support host
scp /tmp/redwood-debug-01f3a9e2.tar.gz support@uploads.redwood.example.com:/incoming/
```
kevin: Also send them a minimal curl repro we can run ourselves (remove real creds):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \ 
     -H "X-Request-ID: 01f3a9e2-9c4b-4a1e-b2d6" \ 
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
     -d '{"input":"hello"}' \ 
     https://api.private.customer.example.com/v1/generate
```
maya: They shared the presign attempt log snippet — looks like S3 responded with AccessDenied on PUT: 
```
PUT https://s3.amazonaws.com/… 403 AccessDenied
x-amz-request-id: 9F1A2B3C
x-amz-id-2: ...
```
alejandra: Common causes: corporate proxy blocking PUT/PUT+Content-MD5, signed URL expired, or clock skew on host. Ask them to run `curl -I "<presigned-url>"` and also `openssl s_client -connect s3.amazonaws.com:443 -servername s3.amazonaws.com -brief` to validate TLS/proxy handshake.
kevin: For redaction guidance include a small redact.json example they can drop into /etc/redwood/redact.json: 
```json
{
  "redact": ["Authorization","access_token","refresh_token","api_key","ssn","email"]
}
```
maya: If the collector fails to start, ask for `sudo journalctl -u redwood-collector -n 200 --no-pager` and `sudo systemctl status redwood-collector`. Also request `sha256sum /tmp/redwood-debug-01f3a9e2.tar.gz` after they generate it so we can verify integrity on upload.
collector-bot: Reminder: presigned upload windows default to 15m. If you need a longer window request a new presign via support with the ticket reference.
alejandra: Fallbacks we accept if presign is blocked: scp to uploads.host (see above) or encrypted ZIP to the support SFTP. For scp include this command: `scp /tmp/redwood-debug-01f3a9e2.tar.gz support@uploads.redwood.example.com:/incoming/01f3a9e2/` and send the sha256.
kevin: I'll take the bundle when it arrives and run the local repro with the provided curl header and the collector logs. I'll also grep the tarball for `trace_id` and the gateway request_id. 
maya: Thanks — I'll send these steps to the customer and ask them to run the online collect first, fall back to offline+scp if presign fails. Will ping here once they upload. :thumbsup:
